Elena K: Heads up — flagged a mismatch on invoices for cohort 'segment-B' after the small A/B price change rolled yesterday. Some customers who should be grandfathered are showing new tier charges. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Marco L: looking into logs now. Can you paste 1 customer id that was charged incorrectly?
Elena K: Customer: ACME-42, invoice 2026-03-06-ACME-123. Charged new 'pro-plus' rate, should be preserved under grandfathering rules.
Priya S: Thanks. The cohort mapping used for the experiment had an overlap window during migration — might explain it. Which rollout flag did they land on? @Marco L can you check routing for model-tier mapping?
Marco L: On it. Running the reconcile job for that customer.
billing-bot: Reconcile report for invoice 2026-03-06-ACME-123: expected_rate=0.035/token, applied_rate=0.045/token, reason=ratecard_version=2026-03-05-v2, grandfather_flag=false
Samir R: That 'grandfather_flag=false' is the issue. The gating service should set it true for accounts in legacy cohort. @Priya S did the experiment update change the flag source?
Priya S: I updated the ratecard config to route 10% to new pricecard for A/B, but didn't touch grandfather tag source. However there's a migration script that backfills tags — could have race. I'll check.
Elena K: We need to avoid re-billing customers incorrectly. Ops ask: should we issue a credit or manual invoice adjustment? Also what is blast radius?
Marco L: Quick check: about 42 customers in segment-B got new price this morning. I'll export list in a sec.
Marco L: export: `cust_ids = [ "ACME-42", "BETACORP-9", "NOVA-77", "ORBITAL-2", "CYPHER-11" ]` will DM full CSV to finance.
Samir R: Let's hold credits until root cause confirmed, but prepare a pre-approved credit template. Finance ok to auto-apply once we confirm mass error? @Elena K
Elena K: Agreed. Finance greenlight for auto credit up to $5k per account if we confirm flagging bug. We'll need approval records.
Priya S: Found culprit: rollout backfill job overwrote grandfather_flag when merging cohorts. Patch incoming. Planning hotfix in 30m, will pause new rollouts.
billing-bot: Deploybot: hotfix branch `fix/gf-tag-merge` queued for canary at 1767837867. :rocket:
Marco L: After hotfix we should run a full reconciliation across last 48h. I'll schedule.
Samir R: Action items: (1) Marco run full reconcile and export list (2) Priya pause rollouts + patch deployed (3) Finance prepare credit template (4) Elena coordinate customer comms if >10 accounts
Elena K: I'll draft a short note for affected customers. Keep updates here. Thanks all :heart:
